verdict.rationale: Mercury's own security page and homepage say partner-bank sweep networks automatically spread deposits across up to 20 banks, giving up to $5M in FDIC insurance without opening multiple accounts. Mercury Vault shows how funds are protected. Coverage is subject to pass-through insurance conditions. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the sweep, and documentation of sweep mechanics or controls (thresholds, bank selection, opt-out).

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can have deposits automatically swept across partner banks to maximize FDIC insurance coverage

citations.quote: This sweep network provides up to $5M in FDIC insurance by automatically spreading your deposits across up to 20 different banks, without requiring you to open and manage multiple accounts.
Get up to $5M FDIC insurance through our partner banks and their sweep networks to ensure eligible deposits are protected.
